query: SELECT p.actor_id AS "reader_actor!: String", a.canonical_identity AS "reader_identity?: String", p.joined_epoch AS "joined_epoch!: i64", p.joined_position AS "joined_position!: i64" FROM thread_participation p LEFT JOIN actors a ON a.actor_id=p.actor_id WHERE p.thread_id=? AND (? IS NULL OR (a.canonical_identity,p.joined_epoch,p.joined_position)>(?,?,?)) ORDER BY a.canonical_identity,p.joined_epoch,p.joined_position LIMIT ?
